meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

copy.tagline: 将Python应用部署到Azure App Service
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的Python应用需要部署到Azure App Service
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: 把 Python 写的 Flask、Django、FastAPI 等应用部署到 Azure App Service(Linux)。会自动建资源组、托管计划和 Web 应用,按框架设启动命令并开启构建开关,用 azd 或 az 命令上传代码,最后输出 https 开头的访问网址。部署后不做健康检查。
howto.when: 当你说出“Flask App Service”“Django App Service”“FastAPI App Service”等关键词,或要求把 Python 代码部署到 Azure App Service 时触发。不适用于容器应用、函数、非 Python 项目等场景。

say.text: 帮我部署 Flask App Service。
say.note: 会创建资源组、计划和应用并上传代码。

say.text: 把 Django App Service 部署一下。
say.note: 检测到 Django 时自动识别启动。
会设置 uvicorn 启动命令再上传。

howto.what_en: Deploys Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) to Azure App Service Linux. Creates RG/plan/app if missing, sets startup command, enables build flag, uploads code, prints an https URL. No post-deploy health check.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'Flask App Service', 'Django App Service', 'FastAPI App Service', or ask to deploy Python to Azure App Service. Not for Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, etc.

say_en.note: Sets uvicorn startup command before upload.
